The format of the tournament remained the same as the [[1994–95 Honduran Liga Nacional|previous season]]. [[Club Deportivo Olimpia]] won the title[https://www.rsssf.org/tablesh/hond96.html RSSSF.com – Honduras 1995/96] – 11 December 2009 after defeating [[Real C.D. España]] in the finals.
